items.title: Actual posterior score and covariance identities

source.anchor: arXiv:2609.06906v1 Section4.1 equation4.1 HTML403-412; Section3.1 unnormalized convolution convention; PBPS2609.06905v1 Section2.2 actual Gaussian augmentation/selected backward quadratic tilt
source.attribution: Fan Chen, Sinho Chewi, Jianfeng Lu, Matthew S. Zhang; ASTIS original mathematical restatement of equation4.1, with explicit arbitrary-probability and constant-prefactor generalizations.

items.statement: At every observation y, R_y is a probability measure and the identity map belongs to L2(R_y). For every direction v, DU(y)[v]=inner(y-mean(R_y),v)/eta. For every v,w, D2U(y)[v,w]=inner(v,w)/eta-covarianceBilin(R_y)(v,w)/eta^2. These are actual first and second Frechet derivatives and actual finite posterior moments; the constant positive prefactor cancels exactly.
assumptions: E is a finite-dimensional real inner-product space with its Borel measurable space, including dimension zero. mu is an arbitrary probability measure; eta>0 and C>0 are real numbers. No input density, finite input moments, input potential, smoothness, curvature, normalizer or conditional-version certificate is assumed.

Z(y)=integral exp(-norm(y-x)^2/(2eta))dmu(x), R_y=mu.tilted(-norm(x-y)^2/(2eta)), U(y)=-log(C Z(y)). C is an arbitrary positive constant prefactor; choosing the actual Gaussian C_eta gives its negative-log probability density. Other C values are not asserted to normalize a density.

R_y is the actual everywhere-selected posterior of the Gaussian augmentation, previously identified as a measurable Markov/disintegration kernel. Probability and finite second moments are derived here; mean is the Bochner integral, covarianceBilin is the true centered bilinear covariance. The new theorem concerns this selected version, never an arbitrary conditional representative.

For the source Gibbs input, the actual source unnormalized potential V_eta differs from the normalized density potential U_eta by the already-proved constant log Z_V. The genuine Test derives original Gibbs probability from C2 and positive lower Hessian, proves source V_eta directional derivative/covariance identities by this exact constant, and joins the same augmentation backward kernel. Source Hessian upper bound and eta upper cap are unnecessary for these identities.

formulae.label: Actual Gaussian posterior derivative identities
formulae.tex: R_y(dx)=Z(y)^{-1}e^{-\|x-y\|^2/(2\eta)}\mu(dx),\quad X\in L^2(R_y),\quad DU(y)[v]=\eta^{-1}\langle y-\mathbb E_{R_y}X,v\rangle,\quad D^2U(y)[v,w]=\eta^{-1}\langle v,w\rangle-\eta^{-2}\operatorname{Cov}_{R_y}(\langle v,X\rangle,\langle w,X\rangle).

obligations.label: Equation4.1 actual posterior score/covariance, with finite moments and source normalization
Higher regularity, dynamics, errors/work and both complete main/composition (remaining)

bindings.boundary: Actual everywhere-selected quadratic Gaussian posterior has probability and finite second moments, without input moments; true first/second derivatives of negative log of the Gaussian normalizer equal posterior mean and covariance, including the positive constant prefactor and dimension zero. No Brascamp-Lieb/Cramer-Rao covariance inequalities, source Hessian bounds/higher cumulants, stationarity/algorithm accuracy/history/expected work, PBPS process or either complete main/composition. TV never transfers unbounded expected cost.
